admission.justification: At least one proof names this invariant's exact behavior at the candidate.

applicability: Ordinary and direct exact-tree publication, both prepared repository legs, and integration pre-ref admission.
conditions: The repository pre-commit hook is resolved for the worktree and judged tree; absence is recorded as hook=none, not a skipped configured check.
Failed, unrunnable, timed-out or tracked/index-mutating hooks refuse publication before ref movement.
Successful admission records a tree-bound Commit-Check-Pass fact.

Integration trusts the parsed tree-matching landing trailer as its fact; this is not independent authentication of historical hook execution. With no matching fact, it runs the check before master refs move.
exclusions: Commit-tree does not itself invoke commit-msg, prepare-commit-msg or post-commit; the explicit repository pre-commit check precedes it.
Prepared code and memory use ordinary git commit hooks; a legacy strict-code-no-verify journal spelling is not a bypass.
Reference-transaction hooks retain their separate native ref-movement role.
statement: Product landing publication requires the repository pre-commit check on the exact judged tree before a new commit is published or its ref moves. Ordinary/direct commit-tree routes run the explicit check; prepared code and memory retain ordinary hooks without bypass. Integration requires a matching tree-bound Commit-Check-Pass fact or reruns the repository check on that candidate tree.
